versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-crawler-guaikei.

- Provides tools for querying and analyzing Douyin (抖音) public data: video/text search, hot trends, user posts, and video comments.
- Supports filtering and sorting by likes, publication time, duration, and content type.
- Requires only public info (no login needed) and is safe against account risks.
- Returns structured JSON for easy downstream processing and analysis.
- Usage examples and clear boundaries described for intended scenarios.
